column1: Non-domestic electricity prices in the EU
Data period: New prices data for Semester 2 2025 (July - December 2025) and historical revisions
Data in these tables shows prices of electricity for non-domestic consumers in the UK and EU.
Data is presented by size band, with and without tax and for six-month periods ("semesters") each year (January - June and July - December).
